{{Quote|Its a huge, red lizard that's built like a Baragwin battle tank. It has a hide so thick it might as well be durasteel plating.|Mandalorian guard captain|<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Zakkegs''' were rare alpha-predators [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Huge, armored quadrupeds, they were solitary and territorial. Even [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were impressed by someone who killed one, and one could gain great honor for proving one's success. They preyed upon most creatures which they could catch, including [[cannok]]s, [[maalraas]] and even [[boma]]s.

==History==
{{Quote|Behemoth, like a tank with a temper. Caught it under the chin with a concussion missile, took two.|[[Torian Cadera]]|<ref name="TOR:HP">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Torian Cadera|Hunting Party}}</ref>}}
[[File:JuvenileZakkeg.png|thumb|200px|A juvenile zakkeg.]]
When [[Meetra Surik]] arrived on Dxun, she had to prove herself worthy to [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore]] to get transportation to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Upon hearing that killing one of these beasts was considered honorable, she took up the challenge and, with the help of her companions and the young Mandalorian [[Davrel]], she killed the zakkeg and gained significant respect from the Mandalorians.

Years later during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], there was still a Mandalorian clan in existence that made regular hunts for Zakkegs and used the beast's skin to make their armors.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Hunting the Zakkeg}}</ref>
